title: Pay an overdue fine
summary: Learn how to pay an overdue fine online or by calling 13 77 88.
intro:
If you receive an overdue fine, you can pay it or:

Payments for an overdue fine can be made online. Alternatively, you can call 13 77 88.

If you don’t finalise your overdue fine, it may lead to further action such as the suspension of your licence, cancellation of your registration or a property seizure.

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to complete your payment.

faqs.q: What happens if I don't pay my overdue fine?
faqs.a: Not finalising your overdue fine may lead to further action, such as the suspension of your licence, cancellation of your registration, or a property seizure.

faqs.q: How can I pay my overdue fine?
faqs.a: You can pay an overdue fine online or by calling 13 77 88.

faqs.q: What do I need to pay my overdue fine?
faqs.a: You need your overdue fine notice and your personal details. Call 13 77 88 if you need a copy of your overdue fine notice.
